## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits and is in English.
- [ ] Every commit has a DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] `make check` passes locally, or the failing checks are explained above.
- [ ] New behavior has unit tests and, for nodes, a golden workflow and expected result.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated for user-visible changes.
- [ ] No CJK characters were added to documentation or configuration files.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data, or build outputs are included.
- [ ] Required CI checks are green and at least one maintainer has approved.
